subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related merged fixes preserved that behavior, and adding a setting would cross the repo's high bar for new config or environment surface.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve current compact display and narrow future fixes to corrupted or non-copyable path cases.

options.title: Switch To Full Paths
options.body: Make full absolute paths the default across central display helpers, prompts, docs, and tests.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep the current default but add a documented opt-in mode after maintainers choose the config or environment contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve current compact display and narrow future fixes to corrupted or non-copyable path cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The product-contract question cuts across shared display helpers and CLI/TUI ergonomics, and steipete has the strongest recent path-history signal across those surfaces.
